written.headline: Disruptive raises $10 billion fund to back AI, defense and software startups
written.summary: Dallas‑based investment firm Disruptive closed a $10 billion megafund to invest in AI, defense and software startups. The fund doubles the firm’s assets under management and will back ten later‑stage companies with $1 billion each.

written.headline: Apple adds AI assistant to Pages, Keynote and Numbers
written.summary: Apple is rolling out an AI‑powered iWork Intelligent Assistant in its productivity apps Pages, Keynote and Numbers. The assistant, built on Apple and OpenAI models, can draft text, design slides and organize data, and is available in beta to Apple Creator Studio subscribers on devices running iOS 27, iPadOS 27 or macOS 27.

written.headline: Anthropic reports 85% gross margin in H1 from model services
written.summary: Anthropic's S‑1 filing shows an 85% gross margin for the first half of the year from running its AI models, countering skeptics who doubted pay‑as‑you‑go model sales could be profitable.

written.headline: General Compute raises $100 million Series A at $800 million valuation
written.summary: General Compute secured a $100 million Series A led by Blackbird and Abstract, valuing the startup at $800 million post‑money. The company focuses on bare‑metal inference chips and rents space in existing data centers.
